description: Structural assertion: the derivation source text contains no Date, $now, now() or Math.random reference.
why_it_exists: The WF4 outbound delivery key was once derived with $now in the basis, so a second attempt at the same approved delivery produced a different send_key and a different communication_id. An uncertain send result (a timeout after the message had actually gone) therefore resolved to a brand new row on retry, and the same letter could be sent to an insurer twice with no duplicate detectable anywhere in the register. The regression was literally a clock read inside the key basis, so the test asserts on the source text of the three derivation functions rather than only on their outputs - an output-only test cannot distinguish a stable key from a clock that has not ticked yet.
assertions: matching the forbidden pattern against the concatenated source of normEmail, fnv1aHex and deriveDelivery yields zero matches

PORTABILITY CAVEAT: this assertion inspects function source text, so a portable runner must keep the three functions as named function declarations it can stringify, or replace this with a static lint rule over the production node body.
